author: jsign
content:
The [Sepolia stateless inputs bucket](https://pub-afa6b160acfb4919bda1d0e2a00b5b77.r2.dev/testnets/sepolia/index.html) now follows tests-zkevm v21.0.7

Since v21.0.7 had a new `new_payload_request_root` due to now aligning with CL container types, the `new_payload_request_root` semantic changed. So, we backported every existing batch since the Amsterdam fork to the new `new_payload_request_root`, so the whole bucket is consistent. (i..e. only the first 32 bytes of `statelessOutputBytes` changed, and `statelessInputBytes` stayed the same)

A few extras:
- The archive checksums changed, so download again any batch you cached before.
- `manifest.json`, `batches.jsonl` and each fixture now have a `testsZkevmVersion` field, so you can tell which root a batch carries. (e.g. `"testsZkevmVersion": "v21.0.7"` so becomes easier to identify potential similar situations in the future when consuming the bucket.
